_readme: Accepted HIGH/CRITICAL runtime advisories for `npm run check:dependency-audit`.
An entry here means: we know about this, we have decided it is not worth acting on YET, and here is when we will re-decide.
Empty is the healthy state. Reach for an upgrade or a removal first — accepting is the last resort.
id       GHSA id, e.g. "GHSA-mwp4-54f8-5fhr" (from the advisory url npm prints)
reason   why it is not exploitable HERE. Name the code path. A generic 'low risk' is not a reason.
expires  YYYY-MM-DD. Past this date the build FAILS until someone re-decides. Keep it short — a quarter at most.
Entries cannot rot: an expired entry fails the build exactly like an unlisted advisory.
